items.title: anthropics/commerce-agents
items.why: It provides a clear template by Anthropic for building practical AI agents in real-world industries.
items.summary: An open-source blueprint showing how to use Claude to create shopping and merchant agents across e-commerce, retail, and entertainment.

items.title: vinzdg/codenotch
items.why: If you use AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Cursor, this tool helps you monitor your usage caps right on your screen.
items.summary: A macOS desktop utility that displays remaining usage limits for popular AI coding tools along your screen edge.

items.title: okf-memory/okf-agent-memory
items.why: It shows how persistent memory is implemented for AI coding assistants to keep context without wasting API tokens.
items.summary: A memory system for AI coding agents that saves relevant conversation context locally in Git to reduce token usage.

items.title: lnkiai/m3e-canvas
items.why: It is a practical tool that helps you design user interfaces visually and turn them directly into AI coding prompts.
items.summary: A web app that lets you sketch user interface screens in the browser and automatically convert them into prompts for AI code generation.

items.title: pierrenade/short-video-generator-AI
items.why: It is a hands-on project demonstrating how AI audio, video processing, and subtitling tools can be combined into one workflow.
items.summary: An open-source tool that automatically turns longer videos into short clips with AI highlight detection, voiceovers, and subtitles.

items.title: shadcn-ui/cn
items.why: It comes from the creator of shadcn/ui and is useful to know if you are learning modern web development with Tailwind CSS.
items.summary: A new, high-performance engine for merging Tailwind CSS styling classes in web applications.

items.title: ahujasid/camera-to-blender
items.why: It is an intuitive open-source project showing how computer vision can bridge physical objects with 3D modeling software.
items.summary: A tool that lets you capture photos of real-world objects and import them directly into Blender as 3D assets.

items.title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
items.why: It gives you insight into how leading AI labs like OpenAI are structuring their internal workflows to speed up research.
items.summary: A discussion offering a look inside OpenAI at how they use modern AI tools to accelerate machine learning research.

items.title: Germany's far-right AfD set for big win in eastern state, just short of majority
items.why: It highlights a significant political shift in European politics that could impact regional policy and stability.
items.summary: Germany's far-right AfD party projected a historic result in eastern state elections, winning 44% of the vote.

items.title: Peace talks rich in symbolism but fundamental differences between Russia and Ukraine remain
items.why: It updates you on major international diplomacy efforts surrounding the war in Ukraine.
items.summary: US diplomatic envoys held meetings with both Russian and Ukrainian leaders, though core differences remain unresolved.

items.title: Iran warns of 'faster, heavier, more painful response' to US attacks
items.why: It is crucial global news regarding growing international military tensions in the Middle East.
items.summary: Iran threatened strong retaliation against the US following strikes on Iranian oil tankers in response to attacks on US warships.

items.title: Five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
items.why: It covers a major fatal aviation disaster occurring at a primary US commercial hub.
items.summary: Five people died after an Amazon cargo Boeing 767 overran the runway at Miami International Airport and crashed.
